entities.name: ReviewPipeline
observations: 2026-06-23: Resumsify phase-end review architecture. Three-column cost-tiered design: Column 1 (OSS deterministic, ~170s, BUILT at commit 4d5d08d), Column 2 (local LLM chain via Cline + gemma4:26b + codegraph MCP + slice manifests, NOT BUILT), Column 3 (premium Copilot Opus/Sonnet escalation flag, NOT BUILT). Captured in ADR-0047.

2026-06-23: Column 1 entry point is `npm run review:phase`. Implementation at scripts/review-phase.mjs. Re-runs tsc / eslint / knip / madge / vitest, parses structured counts, diffs against docs/review-baseline.json. Exit 0 = clean, 1 = regression, 2 = infra/parser failure.

2026-06-23: Regression policy — strict by default (any gate count > baseline → exit 1); `--accept-net` flag allows per-gate regressions if total across gates didn't grow; `vitest.failed > 0` is a hard fail in ALL modes (no opt-out).

2026-06-23: Baseline lives at docs/review-baseline.json (versioned, includes commit SHA + capturedAt ISO timestamp). Regenerate via `npm run review:baseline` after landing intentional improvements. Initial baseline captured at ef75099: tsc 22 errors / eslint 495 errors + 10591 warnings / knip 0/0/0 / madge 0 circular / vitest 966 passed + 5 skipped + 0 failed (971 total).

2026-06-23: Ship rhythm upgraded — E→T→C became E→T→R→C with R = column 1 today; columns 2-3 plug in later under the same baseline contract. R is REQUIRED for phase-end / pre-push / ADR-shipping / cross-cutting changes (libs / schemas / types / config). R is OPTIONAL (T still required) for single-file UI tweaks / doc-only commits / scratch experiments. Gate is slow (~170s) — budget for it but don't skip on the work that matters.

2026-06-23: Three-stage chain within column 2 (designed, not built): verify → categorize → act. Verify-first build order to de-risk hallucinated findings before adding the action loop. First prototype target: worklog-editor slice (highest existing knownTrap surface in docs/c-yard/).

2026-06-23: Red-team verified — injecting one `any` annotation in an unused src/lib/ file triggers exit 1 with both eslint (+1) and knip (+1) flagging the regression independently. Removing the file restores exit 0. Gate has teeth.
2026-06-23: Workflow recipe at docs/workflows/setup-phase-end-review-gate.md for bootstrapping equivalent gates in future repos or recalibrating after major lint/type churn.

2026-06-24: Tier A enforcement layer shipped (commit 7c7202a, ADR-0048). Three additions on TOP of the existing three columns: (1) lefthook pre-push hook runs `npm run review:phase` automatically — closes 'forgot to test' failure mode; (2) Semgrep Community + 3 seed slice-trap rules wired as hard-fail pre-step inside review-phase.mjs (no-window-prompt WARNING for 56-callsite debt; no-radix-onselect ERROR; no-dropdown-trigger-onclick ERROR); (3) Dependabot for npm + GitHub Actions ecosystems. Activates only on push to remote (no-push session 2026-06-24 deferred activation).

2026-06-24: Semgrep cross-platform install pattern: `python -m pipx install semgrep` installs to ~/.local/bin (NOT on Windows PATH by default). Wrapper at scripts/review-semgrep.mjs resolves via PATH → ~/.local/bin/semgrep.exe → ~/.local/pipx/venvs/semgrep/Scripts/semgrep.exe. Use `languages: [typescript]` (NOT [tsx] — Semgrep rejects). Glob patterns must prefix with `**/` (e.g. `**/src/**/*.tsx`) for unanchored Semgrepignore-v2 behaviour.

2026-06-24: Slice traps codified as Semgrep rules become deterministic Column 1 gates that fire repo-wide for free, freeing Column 2 LLM cost for novel-semantic issues. Each rule starts as WARNING if existing debt would flood the gate, then promoted to ERROR after debt cleanup — single-line edit `severity: WARNING` → `severity: ERROR` permanently locks out the bug class.

2026-06-24: Re-baseline `npm run review:baseline` is required after wiring Semgrep IF baseline has drifted since last update. Today: baseline jumped ef75099 → 7c7202a; tsc 22→29, eslint 495→519, knip.deps 0→1 captured as new floor (drift was pre-existing debt, not Tier A side-effects).

2026-06-24: Tiers B/C/D explicitly deferred with re-entry triggers in /memories/repo/parked-ideas.md `Review pipeline — Tiers B/C/D` entry. B = coverage gate / trailer enforcement / weekly review-queue stub / WARNING→ERROR promotions / Semgrep --baseline-commit mode. C = group-coordination tools rejected for solo-dev (CodeRabbit/Greptile/CI/branch protection/SonarQube). D = observability/dashboards (data-bottleneck triggers). Don't re-litigate the C rejection — it's structural, not preference.

2026-06-24: Workflow recipe at docs/workflows/add-review-enforcement-layer.md covers adding a lefthook hook, Semgrep rule, or Dependabot ecosystem. Captures the 5 first-attempt failures (semgrep tsx-language reject, glob-prefix warnings, pipx-PATH cross-platform, lefthook auto-template, re-baseline requirement).
